subject: english
question:
**Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A. Between renunciation of the social world

B. The first point to note

C. And asceticism

D. Is the intimate link
solution:
The correct answer is **"B, D, A, C."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• T
